title: MA in a Related Field (after BSW)

value.body: Beyond the MSW, BSW graduates often take an MA in development studies, sociology, psychology, rural development, gender studies or public policy. These degrees lean more towards research, analysis or theory than the fieldwork-heavy MSW, and they suit different careers.

value.title: How you get in
value.body: A bachelor's degree; a BSW is accepted for most social-science MAs, though some psychology programmes want psychology at graduation. Admission is through CUET-PG at participating universities, university entrance tests, or graduation marks.

value.title: At a glance
items: Development studies and public policy suit NGO, CSR and research roles.
Practising as a clinical psychologist needs a further RCI-recognised qualification, not just an MA.
An MSW keeps supervised field practice at the centre; other MAs may need you to add fieldwork through internships.
